mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 74 degrees with clear skies around Verona City Hall. If you are looking up tonight, the ISS will be visible starting at 8:19 PM, rising in the Southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the East Northeast over the Fitchburg and Madison area, where it will appear almost directly overhead.

For city news, residents should be aware that the city has released various notices for the November 2026 general election. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is now accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy, which covers topics like traffic stops and O W I investigations for those who live or work in the city.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can catch a session at Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing Co for trivia. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday and the exciting Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Saturday.

Regarding the weekly police report, authorities have arrested a Madison resident following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship involving a school staff member that occurred on Sunday, August 30, 2026.

Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving up the delicious Dark Chocolate Decadence as the flavor of the day. They will be open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
